description: This file defines an interface class 'ControlBackendInterface' within the 'firebolt::rialto::client' namespace. The interface declares a destructor and two pure virtual functions: 'removeControlBackend' and 'waitForRunning'. It serves as a contract for control backend implementations in the Rialto client component.

classes.name: ControlBackendInterface
classes.description: An interface class that declares control backend operations such as removal and waiting for a running state.

methods.name: removeControlBackend
methods.description: Pure virtual method to remove the control backend.

methods.name: waitForRunning
methods.description: Pure virtual method to wait until the backend is in a running state.
